UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user's personal profile and health-related information within the HealthSphere application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

username.description: Unique username chosen by the user for display purposes.

email.description: User's email address. Used for identification, but authentication credentials are handled externally.

dateOfBirth.description: User's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format, used for age calculations.

gender.description: User's self-declared gender (e.g., 'male', 'female', 'non-binary', 'prefer not to say').

activityLevel.description: User's reported daily activity level, used for calorie expenditure calculations (e.g., 'sedentary', 'lightly_active', 'moderately_active', 'very_active', 'extra_active').

dietaryPreferences.description: An array of dietary preferences or restrictions (e.g., 'vegetarian', 'vegan', 'gluten-free', 'nut-allergy').

profilePictureUrl.description: URL to the user's profile picture.

bio.description: A short biographical description provided by the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

HealthMetric.title: HealthMetric
HealthMetric.description: Records various health metrics for a user over time, such as weight or BMI, to track progress.

id.description: Unique identifier for the HealthMetric entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile this metric belongs to. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N HealthMetric)

metricType.description: The type of health metric being recorded (e.g., 'weight', 'bmi', 'body_fat_percentage').

value.description: The numerical value of the recorded metric.

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the metric value (e.g., 'kg', 'lbs', '%').

dateLogged.description: Timestamp when the health metric was logged.

FoodItem.title: FoodItem
FoodItem.description: Represents a generic food item with its nutritional information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FoodItem entity.

name.description: The common name of the food item (e.g., 'Apple', 'Chicken Breast').

description.description: A brief description of the food item or its preparation.

caloriesPerServing.description: The number of calories per standard serving of this food item.

proteinPerServingGrams.description: The amount of protein in grams per standard serving.

carbsPerServingGrams.description: The amount of carbohydrates in grams per standard serving.

fatPerServingGrams.description: The amount of fat in grams per standard serving.

servingSizeDescription.description: A description of the standard serving size (e.g., '1 medium', '100g', '1 cup').

imageUrl.description: URL to an image of the food item.

isUserDefined.description: Indicates if this food item was added by a user rather than being from a public database.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created this food item, if it is user-defined. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N FoodItem)

Meal.title: Meal
Meal.description: Represents a specific meal or snack logged by a user at a given time and date.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Meal entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who logged this meal. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Meal)

name.description: The name of the meal (e.g., 'Breakfast', 'Lunch', 'Snack', 'Dinner', or a custom name).

loggedAt.description: Timestamp when the meal was logged, including date and time.

totalCaloriesConsumed.description: The total estimated calories consumed in this meal, calculated from its meal entries.

notes.description: Optional notes or observations about the meal.

MealEntry.title: MealEntry
MealEntry.description: Represents a specific food item consumed as part of a meal, including quantity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the MealEntry entity.

mealId.description: Reference to the Meal this entry belongs to. (Relationship: Meal 1:N MealEntry)

foodItemId.description: Reference to the FoodItem that was consumed. (Relationship: FoodItem 1:N MealEntry)

quantity.description: The quantity of the food item consumed (e.g., 1.5 servings, 200 grams).

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the quantity (e.g., 'servings', 'grams', 'ml', 'pieces').

actualCalories.description: The calculated total calories for this specific meal entry based on quantity.

actualProteinGrams.description: The calculated total protein in grams for this specific meal entry based on quantity.

actualCarbsGrams.description: The calculated total carbohydrates in grams for this specific meal entry based on quantity.

actualFatGrams.description: The calculated total fat in grams for this specific meal entry based on quantity.

notes.description: Optional specific notes for this food item entry (e.g., 'skim milk', 'grilled').

Recipe.title: Recipe
Recipe.description: Represents a healthy recipe, potentially recommended by AI or user-contributed.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Recipe entity.

description.description: A brief description or overview of the recipe.

instructions.description: Detailed cooking instructions for the recipe.

prepTimeMinutes.description: Estimated preparation time for the recipe in minutes.

cookTimeMinutes.description: Estimated cooking time for the recipe in minutes.

servings.description: The number of servings the recipe yields.

caloriesPerServing.description: Estimated calories per serving of the recipe.

proteinPerServingGrams.description: Estimated protein in grams per serving of the recipe.

carbsPerServingGrams.description: Estimated carbohydrates in grams per serving of the recipe.

fatPerServingGrams.description: Estimated fat in grams per serving of the recipe.

imageUrl.description: URL to an image of the prepared recipe.

dietaryTags.description: An array of dietary tags applicable to the recipe (e.g., 'vegan', 'low-carb', 'high-protein').

mealTypeTags.description: An array of meal types this recipe is suitable for (e.g., 'breakfast', 'lunch', 'dinner', 'snack').

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who contributed this recipe, if applicable. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Recipe)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the recipe was created/added.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the recipe was last updated.

RecipeIngredient.title: RecipeIngredient
RecipeIngredient.description: Defines an ingredient required for a specific recipe, linking a food item with a quantity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RecipeIngredient entity.

recipeId.description: Reference to the Recipe this ingredient belongs to. (Relationship: Recipe 1:N RecipeIngredient)

foodItemId.description: Reference to the FoodItem used as an ingredient. (Relationship: FoodItem 1:N RecipeIngredient)

quantity.description: The quantity of the food item required for the recipe (e.g., 2, 0.5).

unit.description: The unit of measurement for the ingredient quantity (e.g., 'cups', 'grams', 'pieces', 'tbsp').

notes.description: Optional notes for this specific ingredient (e.g., 'finely chopped', 'diced').

ForumPost.title: ForumPost
ForumPost.description: Represents a post made by a user in the community forums.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ForumPost entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created this post. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ForumPost)

title.description: The title of the forum post.

content.description: The main content or body of the forum post.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the post was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the post was last updated.

likesCount.description: The total number of likes received by the post.

ForumComment.title: ForumComment
ForumComment.description: Represents a comment made by a user on a forum post.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ForumComment entity.

postId.description: Reference to the ForumPost this comment belongs to. (Relationship: ForumPost 1:N ForumComment)

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created this comment. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N ForumComment)

content.description: The text content of the comment.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the comment was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the comment was last updated.

likesCount.description: The total number of likes received by the comment.

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. Access is strictly private, where the `userId` in the path must match `request.auth.uid` for read/write. The document `id` field will match the `userId`.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user, matching Firebase Authentication UID.

definition.description: Stores specific health metrics (e.g., weight, BMI) for a user over time. Nested under the user's profile, providing private access. The `userId` field within the document is denormalized for data integrity and easier querying.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user.

params.name: metricId
params.description: The unique ID for the specific health metric entry.

definition.description: Contains a catalog of generic, publicly accessible food items. Read access for all authenticated users. The `isUserDefined` field is expected to be `false` here, and `createdByUserId` typically null or a system ID.

params.name: foodItemId
params.description: The unique ID for the public food item.

definition.description: Stores food items that have been created or customized by a specific user. Access is private to the owning user. The `isUserDefined` field is expected to be `true`, and `createdByUserId` will match the `userId` from the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user who created this food item.

params.name: foodItemId
params.description: The unique ID for the user-defined food item.

definition.description: Records individual meals or snacks logged by a user. Nested under the user's profile for private access. The `userId` field within the document is denormalized for data integrity and easier querying.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user who logged this meal.

params.name: mealId
params.description: The unique ID for the logged meal.

definition.description: Details a specific food item consumed as part of a meal. Nested under a user's meal, providing private access. Includes denormalized `mealId` for data integrity.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user who owns the parent meal.

params.name: mealId
params.description: The unique ID of the parent meal.

params.name: mealEntryId
params.description: The unique ID for this specific meal entry.

definition.description: Contains a catalog of publicly available healthy recipes. Read access for all authenticated users. The `createdByUserId` field will typically be null or a system ID, indicating it's not a user-contributed private recipe.

params.name: recipeId
params.description: The unique ID for the public recipe.

definition.description: Defines ingredients for a public recipe. Nested under the public recipe, providing public read access. Includes denormalized `recipeId` for data integrity.

params.name: recipeId
params.description: The unique ID of the parent public recipe.

params.name: ingredientId
params.description: The unique ID for this specific recipe ingredient.

definition.description: Stores recipes created or managed privately by a specific user (e.g., drafts, personal favorites not shared publicly). Access is private to the owning user. The `createdByUserId` will match the `userId` from the path.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user who created this recipe.

params.name: recipeId
params.description: The unique ID for the user-contributed recipe.

definition.description: Defines ingredients for a user-contributed recipe. Nested under the user's recipe, providing private access to the owning user. Includes denormalized `recipeId` for data integrity.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user who owns the parent recipe.

params.name: recipeId
params.description: The unique ID of the parent user-contributed recipe.

params.name: ingredientId
params.description: The unique ID for this specific recipe ingredient.

definition.description: Stores posts made by users in the community forums. Read access for all authenticated users. Write/delete access is restricted to the user identified by `resource.data.userId`.

params.name: postId
params.description: The unique ID for the forum post.

definition.description: Stores comments made on forum posts. Nested under the parent post, providing public read access. Write/delete access is restricted to the user identified by `resource.data.userId`. Includes denormalized `postId` for data integrity.

params.name: postId
params.description: The unique ID of the parent forum post.

params.name: commentId
params.description: The unique ID for this specific comment.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for HealthSphere is designed with a strong emphasis on Authorization Independence, Structural Segregation, and predictable access patterns to ensure robust security rules and simplified debugging. 

**Authorization Independence:** This is achieved primarily through path-based ownership for user-specific data. For instance, all personal user data like `UserProfile`, `HealthMetrics`, `Meals`, and user-defined `FoodItems` and `Recipes` are nested under `/users/{userId}/...`. This means that security rules can directly check `request.auth.uid == userId` from the path wildcard, eliminating the need for expensive and complex `get()` calls to parent documents to determine ownership or permissions. For public data like global `FoodItems`, `Recipes`, `ForumPosts`, and `ForumComments`, relevant ownership (`userId`) is stored directly within the document. This allows rules to check `request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId` for write access, again avoiding `get()` operations and maintaining atomic authorization.

**Structural Segregation for QAPs (Queryable Authorization Postures):** Collections are segregated based on their security posture. For example, `FoodItem` entities are split into two distinct paths: `/foodItems/{foodItemId}` for publicly available, generic food items (read-only for all authenticated users) and `/users/{userId}/userFoodItems/{foodItemId}` for food items privately created and managed by a specific user. This segregation ensures that `list` operations (QAPs) are inherently secure and efficient. A user querying `/foodItems` will only see public data, while querying `/users/{userId}/userFoodItems` will securely retrieve only their own private items without requiring complex server-side filtering or client-side checks. The same principle applies to `Recipes`, separating public recipes from user-contributed ones. Community features (`ForumPosts`, `ForumComments`) are top-level collections, signifying public readability but with granular write access based on the document's `userId` field.

**Consistent Access Modeling:** The design consistently uses hierarchical paths for 1:N relationships involving user-owned data (e.g., `MealEntry` under `Meal`, `HealthMetric` under `User`). This creates a clear and predictable security context. Wildcards like `{userId}`, `{mealId}`, `{postId}` are descriptive, enhancing rule readability and debuggability. All authorization fields (`userId`, `createdByUserId`) are explicitly named and denormalized where necessary (e.g., `userId` within a `Meal` document, even though it's also in the path) to support data integrity and easier querying if a document is accessed out of its full hierarchical context, though the path remains the primary source of authorization for nested resources.
